changes: Preserve NCHWc through aligned Split/Concat and equal-shape Add in face and tracker graphs.
Execute unchanged DFL operations only for scales containing an eligible anchor.

method.hardware: Intel Core i9-13980HX, Windows 11, CPUExecutionProvider; RTX 4060 unused by inference.

benchmark.micro_sampling: uniform across each whole video; sequential decode; interleaved videos
benchmark.inference: prepared CPU tensor to returned CPU outputs, including GPU transfers/synchronization
benchmark.capture_to_result: submission to result, including worker queue; excludes camera/driver
benchmark.scheduled_to_result: scheduled video PTS to result, including producer lateness
benchmark.excluded: preview/UI rendering, network, Re-ID, final image saving; models warm before replay
benchmark.startup: new model sessions in an existing Python process; OS file cache not flushed

method.runtime_held_constant: HighQoS, ORT 4 threads, 1000 us spin/backoff 8, OpenCV 1 thread.
method.source_order: User then Wolfhound in A/C; reversed in B. Inference jobs run serially.
method.confirmation_pair: One extra baseline_c then optimized_c pair declared after the first A trials dropped frames. No retries. Retain all A/B/C results.
method.pooling: Concatenate per-frame timings before computing percentiles; FPS=sum(processed)/sum(elapsed).
limitations: External system load and CPU frequency not locked; no worst-case latency guarantee.
Two-video equivalence does not establish broader model accuracy.
Stage timings are nested subsets, not additive to total.
No camera driver, UI, network, ReID or final file-saving latency; no mobile/energy measurements.
Microbenchmarks are prepared-input inference, not end-to-end speed.
Reorder payload counts are logical output bytes, not measured DRAM traffic.
Dropped input frames can change subsequent model-call counts; averages of those trials do not measure equal-work speedup.

structural_budget.payload_scope: Logical output payload removed per call; not measured DRAM traffic or MAC count.

assessment.status: Exact CPU graph optimizations delivered as opt-in compiler flags; overall mean latency improvement is not established on both videos.
assessment.all_trial_pooling: User mean improves, Wolfhound mean worsens; both total P99 values improve. Dropped-frame trials have different downstream work.
assessment.confirmation_pair: Both C runs decode/process every frame, but optimized mean is slightly slower on both videos; Wolfhound P95/P99 improves, user P95/P99 worsens.
assessment.selection_sensitivity: baseline_b Wolfhound drops frame 21: face calls become 240 instead of 286 and selection becomes front 20 / left 234 / right 144. All optimized runs select front 20 / left 278. The full-input equivalence test remains exact.
assessment.unresolved: Intermittent pauses and run-to-run stage variation remain; their cause is not isolated by these measurements. No claim of universal speedup or worst-case latency guarantee.
